title: Jeff's Farm — Mbira Folk (Zimbabwe)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone alto duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Four in the morning, the rows already warm
Jeff walks the red dust before the day has form
Every worker knew his name, every name he knew
The boss who walked beside them, not above, but through

[Verse 2]
Jill had the dairy running before the sun was up
Forty cows by four AM, she never had to look
Every animal a rhythm, every rhythm kept
The farm that didn't stop, the farm that never slept

[Chorus]
Jeff's farm in the red dust dawn
Where the mbira plays and the morning moves on
Jill's hands in the dairy, Jeff's eyes on the rows
This is the farm that Kerri's family knows

[Bridge]
When the rains came they held the line
When the dry came they held it fine
The workers stayed because the boss was fair
The farm stayed whole because they all were there

[Verse 3]
They carried the farm to Australia in the end
Red dust in the memory, a different land to tend
But the way Jeff walked those rows at dawn
The way Jill knew every cow by name — that's not gone

[Outro]
Jeff's farm
Jeff's farm
The red dust road
The farm lives on
